Orthodontic Appliances

Full orthodontic appliance work for your clinic: retainers, night guards and clear aligners, made from your scans or impressions to your prescription.

Download RX forms

What we make

  • RetainerClear or wire retainers to hold the result.
  • Night guardHard or soft guards for bruxism and protection.
  • Clear alignerThermoformed aligners made to your treatment plan.

How it works

  1. SendScan, impressions or drop-off, with a completed RX form.
  2. DesignPlanned and designed in CAD/CAM to your prescription.
  3. MakeMade in the lab, then finished and checked by hand.
  4. ReturnBack to your clinic by track-and-trace courier or drop-off.

What to send us

  • Scans or impressions of both arches
  • Bite registration
  • Appliance type and design notes on the RX form

Questions

Which orthodontic appliances do you make?

Retainers, night guards and clear aligners. If you need something else, call the lab: we may still be able to help.

How should I pack impressions?

Disinfect impressions and bites, bag them where possible, wrap models, secure everything so nothing moves in transit, and label the box clearly.

Do you work from digital scans?

Yes. Scans from 3Shape TRIOS, iTero and Medit are all accepted.

Other services

  • Crown & BridgeSingle crowns to multi-unit bridges, designed from your scan and finished by hand at the bench.
  • Implant RestorationsCustom abutments and implant crowns, from a single tooth through to full-arch.
  • All-on-4 & All-on-6Full-arch implant prostheses on four or six implants.
  • Surgical GuidesGuides that transfer your implant plan to the mouth for more predictable placement.
  • Smile DesignDigital Smile Design blueprints and wearable mock-ups before treatment starts.
